subject: RECORD clause
notes: cite.py --check 13.18.43.4 GR11. The rule obliges the PROGRAM to place the length in data-name-1 before RELEASE/REWRITE/WRITE; the implementation's side is to read it at that point, which it does (GR13 a) - WRITE with L=7 writes 7 bytes (probe/record-clause/p4.cob), RELEASE with L=5/9 releases 5/9 bytes (p6.cob RETURN L=05 'BBxxx', L=09 'AAyyyyyyy'). pb721_zero_length_record sets L=0 before WRITE and expects a zero-length record.
